scientific_integrity: A new closed-parameter evaluation of Fourier equal-energy pair counts and the corresponding positive-semidefinite resonance corrections, not a claim to invent the spectral projector formula. Proof is analytic. Prior small-graph identifications are acknowledged and excluded from claimed n-domain.
scientific_limitations: Unweighted adjacency Hamiltonian on C_n Cartesian K_q only, n>=5, q>=3; Cesaro limit rather than finite or instantaneous mixing. Numerical checks finite; the proof treats all parameters. Potential equivalent results in broader spectral-product literature remain possible.
title: Exact resonance corrections and rank revival in cycle–clique quantum mixing
